what: RC1 sources lib-sparse-dirs from PLUGIN_ROOT=CUR_ROOT but CUR_ROOT is the pre-release cache tree without the new lib
scenario_or_breakage: /release Step 7 runs CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/${CURRENT_VERSION} bash $PWD/skills/upgrade-larch/scripts/upgrade-larch.sh. After extracting LARCH_SPARSE_DIRS to scripts/lib-sparse-dirs.sh, the script sources $PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib-sparse-dirs.sh (plan line 25). That file is absent on the old cache dir, so the run fails (plan: fail loudly) or, if sourcing is softened, LARCH_SPARSE_DIRS stays the old list. With the old list, marketplace_sparse_cone_matches (upgrade-larch.sh:52-61,93-99) can still match the existing cone and take marketplace update only, never re-adding --sparse with python — RC1 silent miss on the release that introduces the dir.
suggested_fix: Source lib-sparse-dirs from the executing script tree: $(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd -P)/scripts/lib-sparse-dirs.sh (working tree on /release Step 7; installed plugin root on normal /upgrade-larch). Keep sourcing lib-quiet.sh from PLUGIN_ROOT for cache/prune. Document the split in release Step 7 and upgrade-larch.md.
